title: Table A.5: Benchmark molecular bond angles and hydrogen-bond cohesion ($\mathcal{L}_4$, 80-digit Fréchet--Jacobian atlas)
html:
Archimedean specialisation. Molecular bond angles and intermolecular hydrogen-bond cohesion at \mathcal{L}_4 (80-digit precision), solved analytically via T_d / C_{3v} / C_{2v} symmetry reduction in arbitrary-precision arithmetic from the single symmetric-block domain weight rule w(\ell) = q_0^\ell (\sigma \mapsto q_0, \sigma^2 \mapsto q_0^2, e^- = \sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0 \mapsto q_0^3) with zero angle fitting.
